newsitem.title: USA: Big Flower to sell Webcraft, post charge.
newsitem.headline: Big Flower to sell Webcraft, post charge.

text.p: Big Flower Press Holdings Inc on Monday said it sold its Webcraft Games Inc unit for undisclosed cash terms and expected to post a "meaningful" fourth-quarter related to for the sale.

The advertising and marketing services company said it sold Webcraft Games, the lottery production unit of its Webcraft Technologies Inc, to privately-held Pollard Banknote Ltd, which was based in Canada.
The sale would result in a one-time, non-operational loss in the fourth quarter, it said.
The company said the sale would allow the company to focus on its core personalized direct mail products business.

"With the completion of this sale, Big Flower's 1997 financial performance will not be burdened with the recent price and margin erosion which has occured in the lottery business," President Edward Reilly said.
He said the net cash effect of the sale on its business would be positive.
Pollard bought the stock of Webcraft Games, including instant "scratch-off" lottery printing contracts and dedicated lottery production assets.
